title: 24/7 Brain Stroke Helpline
hero_desc: A stroke is a medical emergency. Every minute counts. Under the leadership of Dr. Praveen Gupta, Marengo Asia Hospital offers round-the-clock emergency thrombolysis and mechanical thrombectomy.
section1_title: Expert Clinical Approach to 24/7 Brain Stroke Helpline
section1_text:
Dr. Praveen Gupta provides world-class diagnostic evaluation and cutting-edge treatments for 24/7 Brain Stroke Helpline.

With over 20 years of experience and more than 300,000 satisfied patients, our multidisciplinary team ensures the highest standard of neurological excellence.
